narrative.offerRewardText:
War comes, adventurer, and with it comes untold horrors. You have done all that could be asked of you and for that you should be rewarded.

Should this... this prophecy ever come to pass...

<Geologist Larksbane turns pale.>

The future of us all could be at an end.

These armaments will prove invaluable to your campaign in this desert.
